name: claude-broker
label: Claude Broker (AI)
description: Send AI prompts to Claude Code sessions on a local claude-broker daemon. Sign in to Claude and run the session pools from the admin (claude-broker ≥ 0.6 manages, watches and restarts them).
author: Surge CMS

configSchema.label: Broker URL
configSchema.help: The claude-broker daemon's HTTP address (usually on the same server).

configSchema.label: Pools
configSchema.help: Session pools: [{ name, count, description }]. A pool is a session label; members are labelled <name> or <name>-<n>.

configSchema.label: Session model
configSchema.help: Model the broker's sessions run (empty = the account default). Haiku is cheapest for summaries/classification.

configSchema.label: Session effort
configSchema.help: Reasoning effort for the sessions (empty = default).

configSchema.label: Frame prompts
configSchema.help: Add the ▶ KIND header and the complete_job footer to every prompt.

configSchema.label: Gap between jobs to one session (ms)
